name: pycares
primary_metric: PyPI Stats last_month downloads excluding known mirrors
note: Binding to c-ares; exposes query callbacks, not a documented parser for caller-supplied message bytes. To be checked against the pinned release.
reason: pycares 5.2.1's public API is a c-ares Channel (query, search, getaddrinfo, gethostbyaddr) that sends queries; its parse_dnsrec(dnsrec) takes a c-ares record handed to a query callback, not caller-supplied bytes. No documented parser for local message bytes. Its parser family is c-ares, verified separately in the C cell.
